sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the presence-only yield-strength input shape with the complete formula-derived constraint b_out/t_fn <= 155/sqrt(sigma_y). Locate canonical terms for flange outstand and net flange thickness, enforce their authoritative owners, QuantityValue structure, decimal values, and millimetre units, retain yield strength in MPa on the ship, and implement the correctly directed comparison without exact equality or accidental passing when any operand is missing.
